SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. C. D. 538
Date 4. 10. 29.
October 4, 29.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 2866, dated September 26, 1929,
and in reply to inform you that there is nothing
in Police records against Mr. J.H. Browning.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Acting Director of Criminal Investigation.

The Consul-General for Netherlands,
SHANGHAI.

-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 866.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CID BUREAU
No. C. D. 533.
Date..26..9..29.

SHANGHAI, September 26th 1929.

Sir,

You would greatly oblige me by letting me know whether
you possess any unfavourable information regarding Mr. Joseph
Henry Browning, who has applied for a visa for the Netherlands
East Indies.

Mr. Browning is born at Elkhorn, Wisconsin, U.S.A. on
February 5th 1877 and is at present residing at 75 Route Vallon.
He states to be manager of the Roberts Art Co., a firm of
interior decorators, who have some time ago opened a branch
also in this city at 50 Nanking Road.

Thanking you in anticipation of the information which you
me able to place at my disposal,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

J. A. Muller
Vice Consul,
for Consul General.

The Director of
Criminal Investigation,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（左侧手写批注：）
Pro & Con.
s.d.D. Reply
J

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。
第866号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处
编号 C. D. 533。
日期..26..9..29。

上海，1929年9月26日。

先生：

若蒙告知贵处是否掌握有关Joseph Henry Browning先生的任何不利信息，本人将不胜感激。该人正在申请前往荷属东印度的签证。

Browning先生于1877年2月5日出生于美国威斯康星州埃尔克霍恩（Elkhorn），现居住在瓦伦路（Route Vallon）75号。他自称是Roberts Art Co.公司的经理，该公司是一家室内装饰公司，不久前也在本市南京路50号开设了分公司。

预先感谢您能向我提供上述信息，

此致
敬礼

J. A. Muller
副总领事
代总领事

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处处长
上海

（左侧手写批注：）
正反两方面情况。
s.d.D. 回复
J
